scenario: [LTIM.4.1.1]: `Time - Time` with the left operand the earlier is `0_s`, at any distance; [RLOW.6.1.6]: the engine's subtraction does not wrap before `FN_MAX` saturates it. `P` holds the first instant (-2^63 ns) as `a` and the last (2^63 - 1 ns) as `b`, so the exact difference is almost -2^64 ns, below the Int range. Rule `far` renders `p.a - p.b`: `0s`. Under a wrap the difference is +1 ns, which renders as a positive `Duration`, and a runtime that raised on it would fire `handler`, which must not fire. PATH PINNED: libds's `Time - Time` arm in `rete/eval.c`, which answers the most negative Int for a difference below the range; the Mercury runtime's `ds.eval.ltim_4_1_time_minus`, the same; `dsc.rete`'s `rlow_6_1_6_saturating` lowering to `FN_MAX(a - b, 0)`.
rules_ds:
schema P scope logical:
    id: Int key
    a: Time mutable
    b: Time mutable

rule far:
    P p
->
    let d = (p.a - p.b)::String
    log info "far {d}"

rule handler:
    ComputationError e
->
    log critical "{e.kind} {e.rule}"
